name: NF-06 authoritative compliance inventory and generated references

files_create.purpose: Canonical active C1-C16 identity, purpose, source check, applicability and consumer summary inventory; no allocation of reserved IDs.
Stdlib-only deterministic generation/checking of bounded README/tools README tables and validator help control summaries from registry.
Registry/implementation/emitted-ID/generated-document parity with removal, duplicate, retired, mislabelled and drift negative mutations.

files_modify.purpose: Generated canonical control-purpose summary table only; preserve unrelated release/version edits.
Generated canonical control reference table and registry regeneration instructions; preserve other module prose.
Generated/help-reference changes only, including correcting C9 root README versus C10 prior-scope distinction; no control behavior changes.
Run registry parity and its negative controls in existing validate job with existing prerequisites; no external source/token/runtime additions.

non_goals: No semantic validator checks, new/renumbered control IDs, changed task routes, installed .nizam edits, DS artifacts or runtime/network dependencies.
No changes to release anchors, immutable corrective candidate or adoption; implementation follows independent NF22 corrective freeze.
No fourth routing skill or replacement governance state machine.

acceptance_requirements.requirement: Every actual emitted C1-C16 ID has exactly one active registry entry with purpose, applicable default/target/payload modes and exact implementation check function. Existing IDs remain stable; C17 stays reserved for evidence shape under docs/nips/NIP-0003-live-runtime-sessions.md and is not allocated by this work.

Deterministically generate or verify consumer README and tools README summaries and validator help against the registry. Missing/duplicate/retired/mislabelled entries, emitted unregistered IDs, missing source functions and changed generated content fail consistency.

Reference/help state that default C9 includes root README independently of NDS; C10 retains shipped docs plus guide. Payload classifications retain exercised/not-applicable/skipped/out-of-scope meanings. HTTP URLs and declared illustrative examples retain current handling.
Core CI runs local parity and regression commands using shipped source and existing dependencies, with no documentation-skills checkout, credential, package or network lookup.

evidence_convention: Exclusive capture records per check/attempt; retain mutation expected failures within passing discrimination tests; focused workflow/source review separately records unchanged core dependency boundary.
role_allocation: Standard first_contact combines Planner/Generator/Validator; root independently reviews testability and QA.
execution_gate: Do not implement before this contract is independently approved and root confirms independent NF22 corrective candidate frozen.
